i.e. "A temporary one time password reset link should be used instead."

A further suggestion: For high protection requirements  (e.g. online banking) the one time password should be transported via an independent sidechannel (e.g. SMS).

comments.body: "Verify memorized secret credential recovery, does not reveal the current memorized secret and that a system generated new memorized secret is not sent in clear text to the user. Lookup codes or a random, time limited one time reset link should be used instead."
